items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Sinatra, Tony, Bing Crosby was wonderful in his own way, he actually blazed the trail, he was the first really good microphone singer.

ctx.x: They’re not much fun to write for either.

Some are better than others but I don't see how anybody can get any intimacy when they’re singing that loud, it's an old tradition of singing, hit the fourth balcony type of singing. And some people think that's a great thing to do, well it's an endurance contest that's for sure, it’s hard on the instrument. But I always like the Billie Holiday, Peggy Lee, Carmen McRae, good straight-forward singers that are very musical, Jeri Southern, I mean these are the kinds of singers that personally I like the best.…
Now you were talking about Shirley Horn, you came – Shirley is a relatively recent collaboration of yours so I’d like to talk about that a bit.
